subject: Insurance
title: Hurricane Andrew Changes Everything
description: One-minute skill: Hurricane Andrew Changes Everything.

hook.text: Hurricane Andrew hit Florida in 1992 and caused $27 billion in losses. Eleven insurance companies went bankrupt.

buildup.text: Florida had grown massively, but insurers hadn't updated their catastrophe models. They underestimated the risk.

discovery.text: Andrew created the catastrophe modeling industry.

twist.text: After Andrew, many insurers left Florida entirely. The state had to create a public insurer of last resort.

climax.text: Andrew proved that wishful thinking about risk leads to bankruptcy.

punchline.text: Eleven insurers bankrupt. Andrew forced insurance to embrace computer models.

quiz.question: What did Hurricane Andrew create in the insurance industry?
